title: The Evolution Strategies Paradox: Better Models from Worse Perturbations
summary: Across model and task experiments, sampled ES offspring could score below the parent while the aggregated update improved it, a distinct optimization dynamic.
organization: Cognizant AI Lab; The University of Texas at Austin
